title: Longest Common Substring of Two Strings

content.problemStatement:
Given two strings S1 and S2, find the longest common substring between them.

A substring means:

continuous characters

must appear exactly as-is in both strings

Return:

the longest common substring

if more than one substring has the same length, return the one that appears first in S1

if no common substring exists, return -1

✔ Example

Input:

abcdef
zabcfxy


Common substrings are:
a, ab, abc, bc, bcd, cde

Longest = abc

Output:
abc
